context: A setting MVP_COMPLIANCE_DOCUMENTS maps declared slug to name. A post_migrate receiver creates missing declared documents with no version, refusing with ImproperlyConfigured and writing nothing when any declaration is at fault. A declared slug cannot be changed by save(), update(), bulk_update() or the admin. No template tag, no class, no system check: the maintainer agreed the setting-only shape in session, and ruled that kind and enforcement are never declared.
orchestrator_question: Verify against the RESOLVED Django in .venv, both sides of each rule. (1) research.md says post_migrate connected with sender=self fires once per migrate, on test database creation, and after flush in TransactionTestCase, and that apps.get_model raises LookupError when mvp_compliance is migrated to zero: check django/core/management/commands/migrate.py, django/core/management/sql.py emit_post_migrate_signal and flush.py. (2) Does a receiver that raises ImproperlyConfigured from post_migrate leave a partly-migrated database or any document written? (3) Field.clean(value, None) on the global model's slug and name fields: does it run the custom validators and max_length without a model instance? (4) DocumentQuerySet.update() with slug and a declared row: is there any other route (QuerySet.bulk_update, Model.save(update_fields), admin changelist list_editable) that changes a slug without passing the guard? (5) Does seed_demo still produce the demo's documents, the impressum a notice, once demo/settings.py declares them?
